sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_query
sql_templates.query: SELECT sector, AVG(pct_above_50dma) as avg_pct_above_50dma, AVG(change_5d) as avg_change_5d, AVG(breadth_signal) as avg_breadth_signal FROM breadth.sector_daily WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_breadth_signal DESC;

sql_templates.name: stage_participation_query
sql_templates.query: SELECT sector, AVG(stage2_pct) as avg_stage2_pct FROM breadth.ma_pct_above WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_stage2_pct DESC;

sql_templates.name: sector_stage_analysis_query
sql_templates.query: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, s.sector, s.stage FROM scores.stage_snapshots s INNER JOIN (SELECT sector, AVG(stage2_pct) as avg_stage2_pct FROM breadth.ma_pct_above WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY sector) m ON s.sector = m.sector WHERE s.snapshot_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND CURRENT_DATE AND s.stage = 2 ORDER BY s.stage_score DESC;
